content: Plan: (1) Add pydantic>=2.0 to alcanzai-ingestion deps; add alcanzai-ingestion workspace dep to alcanzai-understanding; (2) Write alcanzai_ingestion/raw_document.py — ContentType enum, BlockKind enum, BoundingBox, ContentBlock, DeduplicationAnchors, Provenance, RawDocument (all Pydantic, frozen=strict=True, schema_version field, UUID job_id); (3) Write alcanzai_ingestion/source.py — CanonicalId dataclass, FetchResult dataclass, Source Protocol; (4) Update alcanzai_ingestion __init__.py to re-export public API; (5) Write alcanzai_understanding/enricher.py — EnrichmentResult Pydantic model, Enricher Protocol; (6) Update alcanzai_understanding __init__.py; (7) Run pyright + ruff to verify clean. RawDocument schema is the canonical definition for the Phase 1 membrane (PIPELINE.md §Layer 3) — schema_version=1, deny_unknown_fields enforced on Rust side in L7.
